risks.risk: Disc condition / whether it actually plays (scratches, missing disc, wrong region, or not included). Photos show only the case front.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the disc (both sides) and a PS4 test boot/loading into the game menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: disc not guaranteed / assume not working until tested.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility mismatch (PS4 region or language) and whether it’s the correct edition.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the disc label and the back cover (barcode/region info) plus a screenshot of the in-game language/menus after boot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: compatibility not confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing items claimed (original pads/accessories and UK receipt).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of everything included laid out (receipt + any inserts/pads) and a close-up of the receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: only the game case/disc, no receipt/inserts.

risks.risk: Seller’s text may be mismatched to the item (mentions overheating/ports which don’t fit a game).
risks.proof: Ask the seller to confirm clearly: is this only the PS4 game disc/case, or is there also a console/device included?
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: treat it strictly as a PS4 game case/disc only.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the disc (both sides) and the back cover (barcode/region).
Send a short video of the game being inserted and booting to the main menu on a PS4.
Show what “original pads” includes (photos of the inserts/accessories) and a photo of the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm the PS4 game title on the case, but they do not prove disc presence/condition or that it works. The seller’s claims about ports/overheating and receipt/pads are not verifiable from the images, so a safe price can’t be set without decisive test proof.
